title: sdlc settings
description: Settings every sdlc role reads from ~/.sdlc/settings.json. A key left out takes its default.

$schema.description: This schema, at the plugin version the file was written for. Editors use it; the roles ignore it.

owned.description: Repositories owned by these users and organizations, and the repositories listed, count as yours: writes there need no approval, except dangerous operations and new dependencies and tools. Your own account is always included. Enterprises can't be listed.

users.description: Users whose repositories count as yours.

organizations.description: Organizations whose repositories count as yours. List only organizations you administer: every repository in one becomes yours.

repositories.description: Single repositories that count as yours, beyond those of the accounts above. A listed repository that is renamed or transferred stops counting.

jurisdictions.description: Where legal and compliance analysis applies, as countries or states. Empty means the legal tree asks first.

inbox_threshold.description: Questions at or above this priority wait in the inbox for you; below it, conductors decide and report. Critical questions, including every approval, always come to you.

span.description: Tasks one conductor coordinates directly per run. Larger jobs split into workstreams of at most this many tasks, each under a workstream lead.

standing_orders.description: Instructions every role follows, one string each.

host.description: github.com, or an Enterprise Server host. github.com entries never match an Enterprise Server host, or the reverse.
